// Classifier fixture, node:test: TAUTOLOGY-ONLY and its negative. Read as text by tests/classify.test.ts.
import { test } from "node:test";
import assert from "node:assert/strict";

test("handles alerts", () => {
  recordAlert("warning");
  assert.ok(true);
  assert.equal(1, 1);
});

test("counts retried events", async (t) => {
  const count = await handler.retryFailedEvents();
  t.assert.ok(count >= 0);
});

test("retries one event", async (t) => {
  const count = await handler.retryFailedEvents();
  t.assert.strictEqual(count, 1);
});
